question:
I have a dbt project using macros, which I would like to be linted. eg I have

/macros/mymacros.sql

{% macro some_macro(val) %}
    to_varchar(val)
{% endmacro %}

I would like this to be linted. Specifically, I would like it to be linted to TO_VARCHAR, enforcing uppercase.

I have tried

[sqlfluff]
templater = dbt

in .sqlfluff This will print the warning: WARNING Skipped file /macros/mymacros.sql because it is a macro

I have tried

[sqlfluff]
templater = jinja

[sqlfluff:templater:jinja]
load_macros_from_path = macros

Which does not seem to do anything regarding enforcing uppercase functions in macros.

I have seen macros/ put into .sqlfluffignore, eg here: https://docs.sqlfluff.com/en/stable/configuration/templating/dbt.html

How come? What should I do to lint macros?
title: How do you lint dbt macros with sqlfluff?
answer:
Don't forget to specify the dialect of the database your SQL is written in. For instance, if you use postgres:

# File: .sqlfluff
[sqlfluff]

templater = jinja
dialect = postgres

See https://docs.sqlfluff.com/en/stable/reference/dialects.html#postgresql
